title: A correction for a whole kind of work — two investor files, both re-thought, both wait

objects.subject: Our call
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Good to meet on Tuesday. Keep me posted on how the first paid pilot goes — that is the milestone we would look at.

Ines Duarte
Principal, Northfield Ventures

objects.subject: Thanks for the call
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Thanks for walking me through Nimbus Labs on Wednesday. When the round opens with a lead, send me a note and we will take a proper look.

Marcus Bell
Partner, Harbor Point Partners
